description: Add one of the organization's own data-box IDs (at most 20; stored lowercase) and re-derive the direction of the data-box messages filed in the matters the caller can reach: sent from one of the organization's boxes is outgoing, sent to one incoming, otherwise incoming with directionBasis unknown. Adding an ID already listed changes nothing but re-derives; recomputed counts the records whose direction changed.

boxId.description: A data-box ID: seven letters or digits.
